sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2019. Change Request Number 2019-020: retire [cca] Cauca (adopted, effective 2020-01-23). SIL International.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; the document retires the code because 'There is no evidence that the language exists' (p.2, sec. 3): Cauca entered Ethnologue via Voegelin & Voegelin (1977:95), is unattested apart from possibly ~10 doubtful Quimbaya words (Adelaar & Muysken 2004:57), and 'all subsequent efforts to confirm the existence of such a language have failed.'

sources.citation: Adelaar, Willem F. H. & Pieter C. Muysken. 2004. The Languages of the Andes. Cambridge: CUP (p.57 on Quimbaya, as cited in CR 2019-020).
